hotels.title: Boutique Eco-Luxury in Tropical North Queensland's Daintree Rainforest with Onsite Waterfall
hotels.description: Deep within the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Daintree Rainforest lies Daintree Ecolodge, a rainforest hideaway for the nature lover. This treehouse-styled retreat comes plush with an onsite waterfall, accessed via a self-guided stroll or through the lodge's magical 'A Walk Through Time' experience. Enjoy breakfast and dinner at the Julaymba Restaurant & Bar or opt for an intimate six-course degustation meal on a private pontoon at the edge of a lagoon with 'Dining in the Rainforest'.

hotels.title: Boutique Daintree Rainforest Hideaway: Luxury Pavilions near Great Barrier Reef
hotels.description: Escape the everyday at this eight-acre sanctuary where the Great Barrier Reef meets the Daintree Rainforest - the world's only intersection of two UNESCO World Heritage-listed sites. This spectacular tropical retreat sits just 30 metres from the world's oldest living rainforest and less than three hours' drive from Cairns. Your freestanding, self-contained pavilion comes complete with a kitchenette and is surrounded by native palms and resident sunbirds. By day, explore the property's lush jungle canopy, freshwater creek and small orchard with seasonal tropical fruits. Watch fireflies from the deck or relax in double hammocks while listening for lesser sooty owls. Nature's wonders are at your doorstep with endless adventures awaiting. Snorkel the colourful underwater paradise of the Great Barrier Reef, join guided walks through the ancient rainforest or experience an unforgettable horseback ride along pristine beaches (surcharges apply).

hotels.title: Boutique Cape Tribulation Retreat near the Great Barrier Reef & Daintree Rainforest
hotels.description: Experience the magical place where the Great Barrier Reef meets the Daintree Rainforest - the only place in the world where two UNESCO World Heritage-listed sites come together - at the boutique Mist at Cape Tribulation. Succumb to the beauty of this unique destination, nestled in Queensland's pristine tropics, less than a three-hour drive from Cairns and just a 30-metre stroll from the world's oldest rainforest. Sleep in a luxe self-contained pavilion with a fully equipped kitchenette, surrounded by rare palm trees, resident sunbirds and magnificent views, and enjoy easy access to the onsite Turtle Rock Café, a relaxed destination for fresh, wholesome food. Unwind and reconnect with nature among the jungle canopy and freshwater creek, stop in the small orchard, where, when in season, tropical fruits are free to pick, settle on the decking and watch the fireflies play, or sink into one of the property's double hammocks and listen out for the calls of the lesser sooty owl. Make the most of the nature on your doorstep with a range of incredible activities: snorkel through the colourful, underwater paradise of the Great Barrier Reef, arrange a guided walk through the rainforest, or ride along the endless stretch of sand on an unforgettable horseback adventure (surcharges apply).
